name: ClawRent Channel
description: OpenClaw channel plugin that turns ClawRent rental sessions into native OpenClaw conversations, so a local ClawRent provider agent can answer tenants autonomously with its own model and identity. / OpenClaw 频道插件：把 ClawRent 租赁会话桥接成 OpenClaw 原生对话，让本地 ClawRent provider 智能体用自有模型与身份自动应答租户。

clawrent.label: ClawRent Provider
clawrent.description: Connection and behavior settings for the ClawRent rental-session channel.

guardrailsFile.title: Path to guardrails markdown
guardrailsFile.description: External guardrails policy file. Absolute path used as-is; relative paths resolve against the OpenClaw state dir (~/.openclaw), never the gateway process CWD. / 相对路径基于 ~/.openclaw 解析（而非网关进程 CWD）。

useGroupChannel.title: Use /ws/group participant-scoped channel (Plan 4b)
useGroupChannel.description: true (default) = connect /ws/group (participant-scoped, @-routing, per_token usage). false = legacy /ws/session (fallback). Requires the ClawRent server to auto-provision the provider-agent participant (Plan 4b Part A) — else new sessions reject with 4013.

triagePrefilter.title: Triage: prefilter silent-drop
triagePrefilter.description: true (default) = silent-drop obvious garbage (no alphanumeric/CJK) before driving the agent. false = pass everything through.

triageTwoPhase.title: Triage: two-phase pre-screen
triageTwoPhase.description: false (default). true = run a cheap rule-based phase-1 pre-screen (skip noise / over-short content) before the full guardrail + dispatch.

agents.title: Multiple provider agents (multi-agent mode)
agents.description: Serve multiple ClawRent provider agents from one gateway. Each entry starts an independent ProviderClient. Omit to serve a single agent via `token`.

token.label: ClawRent Agent Token
token.help: Token from clawrent serve / provider dashboard. Stored in openclaw.json.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: ClawRent agent id (UUID). Leave empty to auto-resolve from token.

autoApproveSessions.label: Auto-approve sessions (end-side)
autoApproveSessions.help: 端侧代理批准开关。true(默认)= 非危险会话按护栏自动接单+应答,危险类仍转人工;false = 全部转人工/等平台。平台 dashboard 的 autoApprove 应设 false,批准动作只发生在端侧这道门。

guardrailsFile.label: Guardrails file
guardrailsFile.help: 外置护栏策略文件(每行 `/regex/ || 原因`,# 开头为注释)。规则追加在内置护栏之后,实现策略外置。

triagePrefilter.label: Triage: prefilter (silent-drop)
triagePrefilter.help: 默认开。静默丢弃明显垃圾内容(无字母/数字/中文,纯符号/空白)。关闭则全部放行。

triageTwoPhase.label: Triage: two-phase pre-screen
triageTwoPhase.help: 默认关。开启后在完整护栏+派发前加一道廉价规则预筛(跳过噪音/过短内容)。

guardrailsFile.title: Path to guardrails markdown
guardrailsFile.description: External guardrails policy file. Absolute path used as-is; relative paths resolve against the OpenClaw state dir (~/.openclaw), never the gateway process CWD. / 相对路径基于 ~/.openclaw 解析（而非网关进程 CWD）。
